title: Indonesia Palm Oil Trading Settlements
thesis: Snowflake turns daily settlement activity from a synthetic Indonesian palm oil trading desk into on-time settlement and overdue-exposure KPIs, 14-day late-settlement risk scores, letter-of-credit headroom anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: On-time settlement rate, late settlements, exposure more than 30 days overdue and open exposure for 120 fictional buyers served from Dumai, Medan, Palembang, Pontianak and Balikpapan.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to buyer-day rows.
The product chart shows which palm oil products run late most often.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of trade-credit KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which buyers should the credit desk call first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each buyer's probability of a late settlement in the next 14 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags letter-of-credit headroom drops per buyer, and the forecast projects desk-wide late settlements for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Is the credit desk keeping up?

talking_points: Payment-commitment rate, document coverage and pending shipping documents frame the follow-up and documentation gaps.
Internal credit score against late settlements by buyer shows an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, buyer, product and risk tables only. It is not trading advice.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a settlement runs late right now?

talking_points: Live settlement events land in RAW.LIVE_SETTLEMENTS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs LATE events with the matching settlement playbook and the buyer's current risk band, then emails the credit desk.
tabs.call_out: From late settlement to credit-desk action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 15 synthetic settlement playbooks.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the playbooks it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
